title: Chapter 886
paragraphs: Chapter 886
Episode 221. An Unexpected Turn of Events (2)
Tikan.
Jin had just returned to Tikan after defeating the three great generals in the empire's newly opened rift area.
"Nari, someone among the demon kings has requested to speak with you."
"What?"
"They are Tilius Biseptus and Misol Hwan, claiming to be merely pretending to serve Zito, but are in fact key figures of the anti-Zito forces."
"What about my sister and Syris?"
"Both are safe. It is said that the two demon kings killed other demon kings during the battle."
Jin's eyes glowed with interest.
'According to Orgal, the key figure of the anti-Zito force was Phaelito, and he had defected… Are there other forces left?'
If it was true, it was good news. Jin headed straight to the situation room without even shaking off the ashes and blood from the battlefield.
"Sister, Syris. Are you alright?"
Although he had already heard from Jet, Jin first asked about the well-being of the two.
{Yes, we are fine, Jin. I talked to them first and they seemed like pretty good fellows. Have a good conversation with them. They are both here.}
"I will keep that in mind, sister. This is Jin Runcandel. I heard you were looking for me."
{I am Tilius Biseptus.}
{I am Misol Hwan. Nice to meet you, Jin Runcandel.}
"Alright, nice to meet you too. It seems there are still some sane demons left in the demon world. I've been briefed on the situation on my way here. What do you want to discuss with me?"
{Biseptus of the anti-Zito coalition, we want to form an official alliance with the Vamel alliance of the surface world.}

"That's quite straightforward. I think there is a lot to clarify first, such as what exactly you are doing, how large your group is, why you particularly want to form an alliance with us out of Inse's forces, and what benefits you can offer us."
{You're right, Jin Runcandel, Tilius.}
{Firstly, what we do is exactly as it sounds – we resist Zito.}
{In fact, we almost succeeded about three thousand years ago. We failed in the end when Phaelito left us.}
"…Three thousand years ago? How old are you guys?"
{We are over ten thousand years old. However, our kind has a cycle of oblivion, so we don't fully experience the whole ten thousand years.}
"Oblivion cycle?"

{It's a process of losing and partially regaining memories over time. Usually once every thousand years, common to all demons except the immortals. That's why relationships are so important among demons. We have to remind each other of the memories we've forgotten. And bury what we wish to forget forever.}
The 'Oblivion Cycle' was a kind of natural phenomenon that only existed in the demon world.
And Biseptus had been standing up to Zito for over ten thousand years, enduring more than ten cycles of oblivion.
"Hmm… I don't fully understand, but I roughly get the idea. However, it'd be better if Tilius does the explaining from now on. No offense, but your speech is too fast for me to follow."
{I understand, I'll keep quiet. Misol, Misol. That's the habit when I act like a fool. Please consider that you didn't hear what I just said.}
"Anyway, you've been resisting Zito for a very long time. That must mean your force is considerable, right?"
{It was during our heyday. But now... around a million.}
"That's an enormous army, isn't it?"
{But among them, only about 10,000 are combatants, and most of them are below 6-star. There are eleven demon kings, including Misol and me.}
"And what do the other 990,000 do?"
{They are just ordinary people. They work, take care of their families, and live their lives. Though our lives are mostly marked by fear and flight.}
Ordinary people.
Tilius's voice resonated with a sense of mission as he said this.
'If what they're saying is true, the Biseptus have been fighting a similar struggle in the demon world to ours. For much longer than us.'
About 10,000 combatants, most of them under 6-star.
Of course, that was also a considerable force, but compared to the demons they were facing at the wall and the high-ranking demons continuously emerging from the rift, it was but a drop in the ocean.

However, with the eleven Demon Kings each possessing superhuman combat power, that alone held enough value to form an alliance. Especially considering some of them, like Tilius or Misol, were top-ranking individuals within Zito's army.
"What's your proof?"

{We have none at the moment. This is the best we can do, communicating via transmission. Here, I can block Sakiel's crystal ball using my powers without arousing suspicion. They would think it's to prevent White Whale and the Lord of Small Bow from space-jumping and communicating during the battle. But if I block Sakiel's view outside Kikaros, it will inevitably arouse suspicion.}
Unless the special power to block abilities, like Tilius's, is not in effect, Sakiel can observe most demons from anywhere using the crystal ball.

{Because of our position as spies, it'll be difficult for us to provide any proof in the future. We have to be really careful even when contacting the Biseptus headquarters. All our hideouts are in the demon world to begin with, so currently, there's no way for you to verify this with your own eyes.}
"Having the ability to block spatial jumps and communications adds another attractive aspect to the alliance proposal. So, are you saying we have no other choice but to trust each other?"

{Rather than trust... I'd prefer to say it's faith. Whether you believe it or not, we're really laying all our cards on the table. We're risking our lives and those of our comrades in this conversation. Don't you have a mage scribe among you? What do you think would happen if they turned today's conversation into a record and took it to the demon world's naval base?}
"If this isn't a plot of Zito's, you would end up dead."
{It's more than just death. We would end up tormented forever, unable to die, just like our family members who are held captive...}
"Family?"

{More than half of the Viseps members have blood relatives, or lovers... someone important being held hostage by Zito. It might even be more than half, considering there could be people who have completely forgotten the existence of their captured family due to the cycle of forgetfulness.}

When Tilius said this, his colleagues, who had been holding their breaths at his side, quietly lowered their hands. Yuria tried to discern if Tilius and Misol's words were true, but Az Mill's ability didn't work on the communication.
'Faith...'

Jin mulled over the word for a few seconds, imagining Tilius and Misol on the other side of the communicator. The faces felt through their impassive voices, their hardened eyes that had gone through a long, fierce struggle. Luna must have felt the same way, hence she described them as 'good friends'.
"Why did you choose us? Have you never made contact with Zipple or Kinzelo?"

{There are two reasons. Firstly, among the large forces of humanity, we judged that you had the closest characteristics to us, the Viseps. Secondly, we never had a chance to make contact with Zipple and Kinzelo. Sakiel is a sharp individual. If Misol and I were to frequently appear in the territories of the various human forces and come back unharmed each time, he would certainly suspect us.}
"So when you were summoned to Kikaro today, it was a one-time opportunity."
{That's right. We might not remember everything, but there has probably never been a moment in the many cycles of forgetfulness when the Viseps took such a huge gamble.}
"Now it's time for you to explain the benefits. What's in it for us if we form an alliance with you?"
{We gain a means to kill Zito.}
"What is that method?"
{I can't tell you that yet.}
"Did you forget what you just said about faith?"

{From our point of view, it's a minimum safety measure. What if you betray us? It wouldn't just be Misol and me who'd be doomed. The only card capable of killing Zito would also disappear. We also can't lie to you. As faith deepens, we'll have to tell the truth, and then, you might get angry and change your mind.}
"You speak very well. Makes one want to believe you."

{Of course, having the means to kill Zito is the most important thing, but it's not the only thing we have. As demon kings, Misol and I can leak important internal information to you whenever we get the chance. For instance... recently, the demon world is hell-bent on completely exhausting the power of the Red King.}
"My sister's red power?"

{Yes, Zito seems to have judged that her red power is a threat to him. It might be a decision of Phaelito... but to the demon kings, it was communicated as Zito's order. That's why the demon kings brought salamander scales today.}
"What happens to my sister if her red power is exhausted? Does the demon world know exactly what's going on?"
{That's information we're also trying to find out through key figures in Phaelito's camp. What's certain is that the demon world wants the Red King to lose her red power. That can't be good for you.}
Jin had been contemplating Luna's red power. Although the discussion concluded it would be fine since Chiron didn't leave any warnings about its dangers.
"That's something I hadn't thought of at all."

{Misol and I, the deceased Viseps and Kukan, we're the vanguard. In the future, demon kings or generals will continue to appear to get rid of the Red King's red power. Even if they find out that they're being used as consumables, they can't resist Zito's orders.}
"Is it because they, like the Viseps, have hostages?"

{No, it's because they're brainwashed. Most of Zito's followers are brainwashed by pain. Pain they can't forget even when the cycle of oblivion comes. That's why there are many among the high-ranking demons who are not mentally sound. Haven't you ever felt something odd while dealing with them?}
{Ah, so that's why the ones who came this time seemed a bit off.}
{Yes, Red King. The Zikal you dealt with before was relatively unscathed from the brainwashing.}
"Then, if there's a way to reverse the brainwashing, wouldn't it be possible to dismantle Zito's power base? I think it might be related to your mentioned method of killing Zito."

{Regrettably, you're mistaken. We've looked for that method for a long time... Even the witch said she couldn't undo Zito's brainwashing. If the witch can't do it, no one in this world can. Unless the dead sun god resurrects. Ah, let me clarify that we are absolutely opposed to the resurrection of the sun god.}
"That's something I like to hear. Alright, I'll ask one more thing."
{...What is it?}
"I have a rough understanding of why the Viseps chose us as allies, their scale and ideology, and what we can gain. But what do you want from us?"
{You're asking the obvious... Fight with us. Until Zito disappears from this world.}

"It's too big a commitment to make right now. However, we were going to fight Zito until his downfall, with or without you. Instead, I promise you one thing for sure. Today's event won't reach the ears of the demon world's demons. I swear on the name of our family."
{So, I should understand it as let's continue to fight in our own positions, and when the moment comes that we can truly show trust to each other, let's talk officially?}
"Yes, Tilius Viseps, Misol Hewan."
{That's enough. It seems fine to end the communication now. But, Jin Runcandel. Regardless of what you think of us, we will consider you as allies and execute all our operations accordingly.}
Before Jin could answer, the communication was cut off. Looking at the communication device that stopped vibrating, Jin cracked a smile.
"Just like my sister said, they seem like pretty decent friends."
